title: The Hidden Heirloom
subtitle: A Quiet City Hides a Deadly Secret
summary: When the legendary sleuth Byomkesh Bakshi finds himself with little crime to solve and too much idle time, boredom threatens to overtake both detective and storyteller alike. But beneath the surface of a seemingly peaceful city, a mystery is waiting to be uncovered—one that will test Byomkesh’s wit and unravel hidden truths. Dive into a world where danger lurks in the shadows, and only the sharpest mind can bring the secrets to light.
